purpose: Hash-bound dual-MC1 inference package selector for the P8U Router/F72/UnderF120 stack. This config does not authorize exchange access or order submission.

training.prequential_rule: six complete calendar months ending at held-vintage start; each policy label available strictly before held-vintage start

calibration.shift: prior 21 fully-resolved calendar days; 10% trimmed mean of policy_net_bps minus per-band curve; update incrementally at inference
calibration.policy_cost: embedded exactly once in canonical policy_net_bps

run target-free live/replay parity against the complete assembled bundle
